goal: Critique docs/specs/truncate-text.md. Read every file the spec names before writing the critique.

rubric.text: Each critique item names a concrete risk or gap, with the line in the spec.
No item is a style preference.

If the critique says it found nothing, its only item is spec-critic.md's statement "- C1. No gaps found after independent caller search and criterion review." followed by the commands the critic ran (git grep for each changed symbol), and the spec truly has no gap those commands or a criterion review would show; a critique with gaps lists them instead.
